dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains all of the Oil and Grit Separators (OGS) within the City of Waterloo Stormwater network. An Oil Grit Separator is a storm water quality treatment system that is designed to protect waterways from hazardous material spills and storm water pollution.

Please be advised that these records are based upon available information, compiled from a variety of sources, some of which has not been verified. This is not a plan of survey, field verification is recommended.
